about_the_game:
🛣️ The Road to Lux…

Amal and Lux were inseparable—until a ruthless underground syndicate tore them apart. Lux was taken by four elite racers who rule the streets, each hiding her behind a wall of rubber, steel, and smoke.

To rescue her, Amal must rise through the ranks of the underground drag racing world, face the champions, and conquer the strip.

Each rival has a unique driving style, intense backstory, and powerful machine. Win the races, master your inventory of parts, and uncover the truth in this retro pixel racer packed with heart and horsepower.

🚗 Customize. Race. Upgrade. Repeat.

Choose from a garage of pixel-perfect cars — from street beasts to tuned monsters. Customize every detail of your ride: upgrade engines, equip turbos, swap wraps, apply spoilers, and more. Every choice impacts your drag performance.

🎮 Full Controller Support – Built for gamepads & keyboards
🎨 Paint Shop – Style your ride with colors and themes
⛽ Fuel Station – Manage your fuel for every run
💦 Car Wash – Keep your machine show-ready
🚧 Garage Customization – Spoilers, wraps, bumpers, wheels, stickers
🧰 Inventory Management – Track every upgrade and owned part
🛠️ Sticker Shop – Personalize your build
💨 Dynamic Drag Battles – Reflex-based, manual shifting showdowns
🌙 Retro Racing Atmosphere – Pixel graphics, neon nights, arcade energy

🎯 Key Features

  • ⚙️ Garage Customization: Modify parts like spoilers, wraps, and wheels

  • 📦 Inventory System: View and equip your purchased upgrades

  • 🕹️ Drag Simulator Mechanics: Fuel usage, manual gear shifts, launch timing

  • 🎭 Story-Rich Campaign: Defeat 4 champions to unlock the truth

  • 🧩 Accessible Yet Deep: Perfect for casual players and simulation fans alike

  • 🚗 Retro Racing & Driving gameplay with modern twists

✍️ Best support from pixelcar Recklessracer team

     Email - contactus@pixelcarreckless.com

We're a passionate indie team pouring heart and soul into this project, and your support means the world to us.

Race to the top and prove you're the fastest in the underground. Updated in real time for all Steam players.

Steam users can request a physical DVD edition — a retro collectible for die-hard fans. Limited time only!

Full gamepad support out of the box — tuned for Steam Deck and living room play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 / 8 / 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: A retro-style 2D drag racing game where you build, customize, and race pixel cars across neon-lit streets. Tune your engine, master manual shifts, manage fuel, and rise through the underground to climb global leaderboards.
supported_languages:
English*, Italian, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
